name: Necrosuchus
sum: Early caiman from the Paleocene Salamanca Formation of Patagonia, Argentina.
holotype: AMNH 3219 — much of the postcranial skeleton, a right dentary and cranial fragments, Salamanca Formation, Argentina.
material: Only the holotype; other Paleocene Patagonian material cannot safely be referred to it.
biology: Lived in a marine or river-and-lake setting in Patagonia about 60 million years ago.
author: Simpson 1937

sources.text: Simpson, George Gaylord 1937. An ancient eusuchian crocodile from Patagonia. American Museum Novitates(965): 1–20.
